Nothing to fix here, just clarifying behavior. Looking at src/ingest/worker.ts: once an import completes successfully, the original uploaded file is deleted immediately from storage (`await storage.remove(upload.key)` in `processJob`). If an import fails, the file is kept for inspection for up to FAILED_UPLOAD_RETENTION_DAYS (currently 7 days), after which an hourly purge job (`purgeExpiredFailedUploads`) removes it. So: successful imports -> file deleted right away; failed imports -> file retained up to 7 days, then deleted.
